evidence: For x1 values 0 or 1 and when the context byte at input+0x428 is set, selects attribute-context status 2 or 1 respectively, converts the looked-up value through f_7000767844, then returns tier 5/4/3/2/1 using thresholds 1.0, 0.6, 0.55, and 0.45; otherwise the default is -2. Caller stores this return value in a result record. The numeric selector meanings remain unresolved. decompiled/main/main_0116.c:18178-18235; decompiled/main/main_0116.c:3683-3687; decompiled/main/main_0056.c:30012-30040
